Definition
[$C([0,T];X)$] 1. ch5:5.9-def-4\group Bochner Spaces The space \[ C([0, T]; X) \] comprises all continuous functions $\mathbf{u} : [0, T] \to X$ with \[ \| \mathbf{u}\| _{C([0,T];X)} := \max _{0 \le t \le T} \| \mathbf{u}(t)\| < \infty . \]
